gaps.explanation: Governmental funds statement p4: Road Fund receipts Local 16,774 (total receipts 560,487) and, under Other Financing Sources, Sale of assets 3,895; Total receipts 1,918,725. The Road Fund budgetary schedule p9 prints Local 20,669 (= 16,774 + 3,895) and total receipts 564,382, i.e. it counts the sale of assets as a receipt. Detail revenue 1,922,620 - 3,895 = 1,918,725 = statement. The statement's 3,895 is recorded in other_financing, not receipts. No fix (schedule line stays as printed).

Governmental funds statement p4, Emergency Road Fund column: Public works 10,092 + Capital outlay 217,070 = total disbursements 227,162. The Emergency Road Fund budgetary schedule p11 prints Disbursements 10,092 only (and an ending fund balance 1,704,631 vs 1,487,561 on p4), so the 217,070 capital outlay is in no schedule and not in detail[]. Detail expenditure: General 1,044,332 (p8) + Inheritance Tax 57,490 (p5) + Road 952,665 + 4,882 (p9/p4) + Road Bond 223,457 (p10) + Emergency Road 10,092 (p11) = 2,292,918; + 217,070 = 2,509,988 = statement. Fix: add the Emergency Road Fund column's capital outlay from p4 (same approach as the Road Fund capital outlay 4,882 already in detail from p4).
